target: relevant-term retrieval with 10,000 stored entries: P95 <= 25 ms (selector retrieval); prompt subset size and omission policy recorded

prompt_subset.omission_policy: budget_limit (S30.1: budget omissions carry reasons, never silent drops)

cold_snapshot_ms.note: one full-table read + index build; the app caches the snapshot per vocabulary revision and rebuilds only on edit

normalize_hot_path_ms.note: normalize() with the loaded dictionary in context, prose without alias first-words (common case; the first-word index keeps non-matching text cheap)
